notes.purpose: Shows one unit's sensor readings with a short history and lets the worker see and set the ventilation fan.
states: How to reach: open a unit that has sensors (Gestation 7-9, Nursery 12-13) and tap the Environment & devices card. No URL param opens the page. The Farrowing and Breeding units have no environment context, so the card is absent there.
Offline (the page default): "Sample readings · offline, showing last available values", Devices "Offline", mode buttons and Apply disabled.
Connected (Connection preview select outside the phone): "Connected", controls enabled.
Chart period Today or 7 days; sensor tab Temperature, Humidity or Ammonia.

elements.name: Page title
elements.logic: Heading with the unit as subtitle.

elements.name: Badge
elements.logic: Marks the page as a design preview; sample data, no equipment connected.

elements.name: Sensor tabs
elements.logic: One chip per sensor with a numeric reading for the unit; readings that are missing or not finite are omitted. The first sensor is selected on entry. With no readings the tabs and detail are absent.

elements.name: Reading
elements.logic: The current value and unit of the chosen sensor. Units: °C, %, ppm NH₃. Sample figures per unit (Unit 7: 22.4, 64, 8).

elements.name: Last reading
elements.logic: unitContext[N].updated, fixed sample time for every sensor.

elements.name: Period toggle
elements.logic: Switches the sample history: Today = 8 points from 00:00 to the last reading time; 7 days = 7 daily points (6d ago … Today).

elements.name: Chart
elements.shows: trend line with 3 y labels and first/middle/last x labels
elements.logic: Sample series = current value + fixed offsets scaled by sensor (temperature ×1, humidity ×6, ammonia ×2); y range = min/max ± padding. Not real history.

elements.name: Low / High
elements.logic: Minimum and maximum of the plotted sample points.

elements.name: Reading history
elements.logic: Table of the plotted points: Time and value.

elements.name: Connection note
elements.shows: Sample readings · offline, showing last available values
elements.logic: "connected" when sync.connection is not offline.

elements.name: Devices heading
elements.logic: Section only when the unit has a controllable device (devices includes "fan"); the tag shows Offline or Connected.

elements.name: Fan card
elements.shows: Ventilation fan · Auto · following unit schedule
elements.logic: Status line: "Auto · following unit schedule" or "Manual · N% speed" for the applied mode and speed (initial speed 45).

elements.name: Mode buttons
elements.logic: Segmented; the pressed one is the draft mode. Disabled offline.

elements.name: Apply
elements.logic: Disabled offline and whenever the draft equals the applied mode and speed.

elements.name: Helper
elements.shows: Reconnect to change device settings. / Preview controls only · no command is sent to equipment.
elements.logic: Offline vs connected.

controls.does: changes the draft fan mode (connected only)

copy: (raw) every string is literal in home-astra-prototype.js; the registry has no environment ids
edge: A unit with devices but no readings shows only the Devices section (the unit card then says "N devices").
A unit with readings but no device shows only the sensors.
Missing readings are omitted, never shown as 0.
rules: "Sensor readings with no numeric data are omitted entirely. A unit without readings or devices has no environment entrance. Controllable devices are independent of readings."
Device changes are disabled offline; no command is sent to equipment.
issues: The "Last reading" time is a fixed 09:40 on all sensors while the status bar reads 9:41.
The offline note appears three times: the chart helper, the Devices tag and the fan helper.
Only a ventilation fan exists; the concept names "devices" in general.
unclear: alert thresholds, who is told when a reading is out of range, and where real data comes from; none are in the code.

notes.purpose: Lets the worker set a fixed fan speed instead of the unit schedule.
states: How to reach: set "Connection preview" (outside the phone) to Connected, open Environment & devices, press Manual. A slider appears; Apply becomes enabled once the draft differs.
After Apply: status "Manual · 70% speed", note "Preview setting applied · just now", toast "Sample setting saved · no equipment command sent".

elements.name: Fan speed
elements.logic: Range input 0-100 in steps of 5, with a live value; the draft is not applied until Apply.

elements.name: Apply
elements.logic: Copies the draft mode and speed into the device.

elements.name: Updated line
elements.logic: Shown after the first Apply; static wording.

edge: Switching to Auto drops the slider; a draft equal to the applied state keeps Apply disabled.
rules: "Preview controls only · no command is sent to equipment."
issues: No confirmation or safety limit for speed 0; unclear whether 0% is allowed on a real fan.

screens.name: Maintenance · open issue
screens.zh: 维修 · 有未解决问题

notes.purpose: Lists the unit's equipment issues and lets the worker report one.
states: How to reach: pick a unit, bottom bar Toolbox › Maintenance (the row appears only when a unit is chosen). Unit 7 starts with one open issue. The `attention` param hides it (clear, health, feed) or adds a default one in other units (maintenance, busy).

elements.name: Page title
elements.logic: Heading with the unit; PREVIEW badge.

elements.name: Open count
elements.logic: Count of records not resolved, singular/plural.

elements.name: Report issue
elements.logic: Text button opening the report drawer.

elements.name: Issue card · equipment
elements.logic: Equipment name and Open/Resolved status.

elements.name: Issue card · location
elements.logic: Free-text location in the unit.

elements.name: Issue card · note
elements.shows: Leaking valve at the east end.
elements.logic: Free-text description.

elements.name: Issue card · reporter
elements.logic: Name and time of the report; "just now" for issues added in the session.

edge: Resolved issues stay listed with a dim style and "Resolved".
The count feeds the Maintenance chip on the unit screen.
rules: "Maintenance offers unit-scoped issue cards, reporting with a pen/location and resolving an issue."
issues: The path to this page is Toolbox, two taps from the unit; the unit screen's Maintenance chip does not link here.
No photo, no priority, no assignee, no history of who resolved it.

notes.purpose: The empty state when the unit has no issue.
states: How to reach: Unit 8 (or any other unit), Toolbox › Maintenance.

elements.name: Empty state
elements.shows: No open issues — Report equipment that needs attention in this unit.
elements.logic: Shown when there are no records at all (resolved issues keep the list non-empty).

elements.name: Count
elements.logic: Plural for zero.

edge: After the only issue is resolved the list shows it as Resolved, not this empty state.

notes.purpose: Captures a new equipment issue in three fields.
states: How to reach: Maintenance › Report issue. Drawer "Report equipment issue". Save is a form submit; blank (whitespace) values are ignored.

elements.name: Equipment
elements.logic: Required text, max 80.

elements.name: Location
elements.shows: Location in Unit 7 · e.g. Pen C2
elements.logic: Required text, max 80; the label names the unit.

elements.name: Note
elements.logic: Required textarea, max 500.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: Adds an open record at the top with reporter "G. Hansen · just now", closes the drawer, toast "Issue saved in this preview".

issues: Equipment and location are free text; no list of the unit's devices or pens is offered.

notes.purpose: Shows one issue and lets the worker mark it resolved.
states: How to reach: Maintenance › tap an open issue. Drawer titled with the equipment, "Pen C2 · Open", the note and reporter in an evidence box, primary "Mark resolved".

elements.name: Mark resolved
elements.logic: Sets resolved on the record, closes the drawer, toast "Issue resolved in this preview"; the open count drops.

issues: Resolving needs no note and records no resolver or time.

states: How to reach: after resolving, tap the dimmed card. Drawer shows "Pen C2 · Resolved", the note, and "Resolved in this preview." with no action.

elements.name: Resolved line
elements.logic: Replaces the Mark resolved button.
